kilauea_notices.title: HAWAIIAN VOLCANO OBSERVATORY DAILY UPDATE
kilauea_notices.message: HVO Kilauea ORANGE/WATCH - Kīlauea volcano is intermittently erupting short, precursory lava flows with 104 recorded since this activity began on September 7. The onset of episode 55 fountaining is likely today or tomorrow, if conditions remain favorable.

mauna_loa_notices.title: HAWAIIAN VOLCANO OBSERVATORY MONTHLY UPDATE
mauna_loa_notices.message: HVO Haleakala GREEN/NORMAL - No activity of concern for Haleakalā.
